## History

Tillie Boulter is a student who attends school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). She is part of the local group of school children in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--tillie-boulter.md)

Tillie Boulter is a classmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). During their time at school, Tillie took Anne's part and stood by her. Their relationship grew through their shared days in the classroom, where Tillie consistently offered her support.
